'''''Dagger 1''''' was an [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|''Assassin''-class corvette]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
At some point prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], ''Dagger 1'' was hauling [[Proton torpedo/Legends|torpedoes]] and its sister ship ''[[Dagger 2]]'' was hauling [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] starfighter parts when they were ensnared by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Mine Type B|type B]] [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] [[Space mine/Legends|minefield]] [[M2]].<ref name="TIEF" />

A pair of [[Missile Boat]]s were dispatched to free the corvettes and defend the repair operation carried out by [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|''Gamma''-class ATR-6 assault transport]] ''Omega'' from the Rebel [[MC40a light cruiser/Legends|MC40a light cruiser]] ''[[Planka]]'', which arrived to claim the prize the Rebel minefield had caught.<ref name="TIEF" />

The Missile Boats destroyed the minefield, the Rebel cruiser, and the starfighters the cruiser launched. The ''Dagger'' group then entered [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to continue their mission.<ref name="TIEF" />
